question.title: Is Unique LCCI
question.content:
Implement an algorithm to determine if a string has all unique characters. What if you cannot use additional data structures?

Example 1:

Input: s = "leetcode"
Output: false

Example 2:

Input: s = "abc"
Output: true

 

Note:

  • 0 <= len(s) <= 100
